verses.text: --¿Mach jun skot t'a niwan chonhab' Bosra, t'a yol smakb'en Edom, chakchak spichul ayochi, te ayxo smay yilji, yet'nak wal yip skoti? Ix tak'wi Jehová icha tik: --Ha in Jehová in tzin jawi, ay in poder in kolwaji. Swalanpaxi to ol in ch'olb'itej yaj t'a stojolal, xchi.
--¿Tas yuj chakchak yilji a pichul, ichato ach tek'wiel yal sat uwa? xin chi t'ay.

Ix yalani: --Yujto ix in tek'em juntzanh nakión icha stek'jiel yal sat uwa. Ha innhej, malaj junokxo nakión ix och wet'ok. Aykot wowal ix in tek'anem heb' wajk'ool, yujto aykot yowal in k'ool t'a heb'. Icha chi' ix aj yoch chititok schiq'uil heb' t'ayin, ix chik'ax in pichul tik.
Yujto ix in na' to ix jawi sk'ual in kolanel in chonhab', swak'anpax spak t'a heb' ajk'ool.

Ix in ek' k'elelok, tato ay mach skolwaj wet'ok. Palta ix satk'e in k'ool, yujto malaj mach tz'och wet'ok. Yuj chi' a wal yuj yowal in k'ol ix in tek'b'an in b'a, yuj chi' ix yal in kolan in chonhab' in ch'okoj.
Yet' wal yowal in k'ool, ix in tek'anem masanil nakión. Ix in satanel heb' yet' wowal, ix b'ey wal schiq'uil heb' wuj t'a sat lu'um, xchi Jehová.

In gana swaleli jantak tzonh xajanej Jehová, tzin b'itan wal jantak tas ix sk'ulej kuuj. Tzonh xajanej a onh yinhtilal onh Israel tik. Jantak tas ix sk'ulej kuuj, ix ok'xi sk'ol t'ayonh, yujto te xajan onh yuj.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha juntzanh anima tik, in chonhab' heb', wuninal heb', manhxo ol meltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin, xchi. Yuj chi' ix koljiel heb' yuj Jehová chi'

t'a masanil syaelal. Manh ch'okok mach ix schekb'at skol heb', palta a wal ix sch'ox sb'a icha ángel yik skolan heb'. Yujto xajan heb' yuj, tz'ok' sk'ol t'a heb', yuj chi' ix kolji heb' yuj. Ix ketzjib'ey heb' yuj, ichataxon sk'ulej yet' heb'.
Palta te pit ix yutej sb'a heb' t'ay, ix yak'an kus Yespíritu Jehová chi' heb', haton Espíritu Haxonhej Ochi. Yuj chi' ix meltzajoch ajk'olal t'a heb', ix yak'an owal yet' heb'.

Yuj chi', ix snaankot heb' tas ujinak t'a peka', t'a stiempoal winhaj Moisés. Ix sk'anb'an heb' icha tik: ¿B'ajtil ay Jehová koljinak heb' ko mam kicham t'a ha' mar, stanhwumal pax heb'? ¿B'ajtil ay jun yak'nakoch Yespíritu Haxonhej Och t'a heb'?
Haton jun sch'oxnak spoder t'a winhaj Moisés. Ha Jehová pojjinak snanhal ha' mar t'a yichanh heb' schonhab', yik sb'inajnhej sb'i heb' t'a junelnhej.
Ha ik'annak ek' heb' schonhab' t'a yich ha' mar chi'. Maj el nhernaj heb', icha yek' nok' chej t'a tzinan lu'um, xchi heb'.

Ha Yespíritu Jehová ik'annak b'ey heb' schonhab' chi', yik syak'an yik' yip heb', icha syak' nok' wakax tz'ik'jiem wael t'a lum ak'liktak. Icha chi' yutejnak yik'an b'ey heb' schonhab' chi', yik sb'inaj yuj sniwanil yelk'ochi.

Mamin Jehová, ilonhkot t'a jun et'tal to iknhej yaji, haton satcha'anh b'aj kajan ach, b'aj manh jantakok swach'il. ¿B'aq'uinhto ol a ch'ox a wach'k'olal yet' ipalil chi'? ¿B'aq'uinh ol ok'xok a k'ool t'ayonh? ¿Mato ix lajwi a niwank'olal chi' t'ayonh?
Ha ach tik, ko Mam ach. Wach'chom a winhaj Abraham yet' winhaj Israel manh onh yojtakok heb', palta a ach tik ko Mam ach, toxonton ko Kolumal ach.

Mamin ¿tas yuj tzonh ik'kanel t'a yol a b'e, tzak'an pitb'okel ko pensar yik manhxa elk'och t'ayonh? Ak'xi a wach'k'olal t'ayonh a chekab' onh tik, a onh yinhtilal onh kan heb' a chonhab' to iknhej yaji.
Ha onh a chonhab' onh tik, sik'b'il onh el uuj, jayenhej ab'il ix ko kaj lum ko lu'um, haxo tiknaik, a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh ix tek'anem a templo.
Ichato malaj b'aj tzak' yajalil t'ayonh, ichato malaj b'aj sb'inaji to ik onh. Ichnhejta' kaji.
